subject: Private deployment network safety sweep & IaC gating for VPC/on-prem bundles
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Liao <chris@edgecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment network safety sweep & IaC gating for VPC/on-prem bundles

Team —

As discussed in the leadership sync, EdgeCloud is asking for a formalized IaC safety sweep before we hand off the on-prem bundle for the pilot. They need clear answers on network hardening, CI gate checks, and what we enforce in the Terraform/Helm/Ansible modules.

Can the infra/security owners confirm the following by EOD Friday?
- Single canonical TF module layout for VPC and segnet (namespaces, route tables, egress ACLs).
- CI/CD gating checklist: plan for terratest, tfsec, and a manual security review step.
- Helm charts: a strict values.yaml schema and admission webhook validation.
- Ansible roles: idempotence checks + secrets handling (KMS/HSM integration).

Attached: iac-safety-checklist-v1.pdf — contains the checklist I want validated and the minimal required evidence for EdgeCloud procurement.

If we can't close these items this week, we should schedule a short call with EdgeCloud to align on scope.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Platform Security (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment network safety sweep & IaC gating for VPC/on-prem bundles

Thanks Grace — quick notes after an initial pass: 

- Terraform modules: we already have a vpc/core, vpc/segmentation, and edge-gateway modules but they need stricter input validation (cidr/prefix, reserved ranges). I'll add schema checks and require explicit route_table attachments (no implicit defaults).
- CI gating: propose adding an explicit Terratest suite in pipeline > run on PRs targeting modules/*. Also add tfsec as a hard-fail step for high/critical severities.
- Helm: add a JSON schema for values.yaml and fail builds when schema mismatch. Also enable a validating webhook in the cluster operator chart.
- Ansible: implement a preflight idempotence run in CI that executes in a staging sandbox; secrets must be pulled via the customer KMS integration.

I'll sketch a TF module diagram and drop it here; will also open PRs for the pipeline steps. If we want a formal checklist sign-off, I can add a tiny PR template that forces evidence links (coverage, terratest results).

Markus

Subject: Re: Private deployment network safety sweep & IaC gating for VPC/on-prem bundles

Appreciate the fast turnaround. From procurement/eng at EdgeCloud:
- The checklist looks good; we do need explicit egress deny-by-default rules and a documented process for customer-managed KMS keys in the bundle.
- Can you also provide a sample evidence bundle (terraform plan outputs, terratest run, helm values schema) so our compliance folks can triage?
- We'll open partnership PRs that mirror your TF module layout so we don't reintroduce drift on our side.

We'll aim to submit the first PRs by Monday and include short PR descriptions that reference the checklist items. Happy to join a 30m call if you want to walk through open questions.

—Chris
EdgeCloud Solutions
procurement@edgecloud.com

Thanks — quick status update and action items: 

1) Markus: open PRs for TF module schema validation and the Terratest pipeline by EOD Monday. Please include a CI badge and evidence file link.
2) Rishi: add a tfsec hard-fail stage to the modules pipeline and create a short runbook for on-call responses to high findings.
3) Hannah/Evelyn: validate Helm values schema and enable the admission webhook in the operator chart; provide example values file for EdgeCloud compliance.
4) Chris: thanks for the PR plan — when you open, please tag the PRs with INFRA-2034. 

If we hit any blockers, let's do a 30-minute alignment on Tuesday (Grace/Markus/Rishi/Chris). I'll update the Jira (INFRA-2034) with the checklist and evidence placeholders.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Platform Security (interim)
